inputs.original_text: asmith@medicinehatnews.com Local organizers are taking to the petition tables, collecting signatures in an effort to protect southern Alberta’s watershed from coal mining. Water Not Coal, started by Corb Lund last month, seeks to collect signatures for a citizen initiative petition which would call on the Government of Alberta to “prohibit through legislation all coal exploration The post Local canvassers now collecting signatures for the citizen-led Water Not Coal petition appeared first on Medicine Hat News .
inputs.modified_text: Water Not Coal, started by Corb Lund last month, isn’t offering a careful plan to protect watersheds—it’s demanding that government “prohibit through legislation all coal exploration.” That’s a blanket ban dressed up as environmental concern, and it risks putting activists’ priorities ahead of the families and communities whose livelihoods depend on work and a strong Alberta economy. Protecting clean water is essential, but responsible government should enforce sensible safeguards and listen to local people, not let a signature campaign turn every resource decision into a choice between water and prosperity.
